title: Passkeys
description: Manage your passkeys for passwordless authentication
browserNotSupported: Your browser doesn't support passkeys. Please use a modern browser with WebAuthn support.
emptyDescription: Create a passkey to enable passwordless sign-in for this account.
passkeyExplanation: Passkeys are a more secure and convenient alternative to passwords. They use cryptographic keys stored on your device or in your password manager to sign you in without typing a password. Passkeys are resistant to phishing and data breaches.
createNewDescription: Your device will create a secure passkey that can be used to sign in without a password.
nameHelp: Give your passkey a name to easily identify it. If left empty, we'll generate one based on your device.
deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete the passkey "{name}"? You won't be able to use it to sign in anymore.
